implementation: Extracted S39 route content to ByoDetailScreen and left the route as a thin token-param wrapper with one useByoDetailController.
Added token/request-keyed loading, available, unavailable, error, and claimed states; stale preview callbacks are ignored, and failed preview reads expose Retry instead of invalid/expired copy.

Captured the canonical booking ID in claimed state before invoking payment. Payment error/cancellation retains View booking and Retry payment actions; Retry payment uses the existing payment path and never calls claimByoInvite.
Preserved server preview amounts, the current 3% fee label/policy, existing login inviteToken intent, and server-side claim validation. Participant and price rows wrap at natural height.
